arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. This is the ONLY corrective revision of a project portrait. Image 1 is the initial image to revise. Images 2–5 are style cores (Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore); do not copy their worried eyebrows. Preserve the same person, sex, age, adult features, head orientation and current-card clothing corrections from image 1. Historical identity has already been locked in image 1.

EXACT SINGLE REVISION: The initial portrait is too worried, too warm-orange/healthy, has glaring white eye patches, and leaves too much neck/shoulder. Redraw her expression with FLAT horizontal relaxed eyebrows (absolutely no elevated inner brow), half-lowered eyelids, tiny dark brown eyes with only one dull gray-beige pixel of sclera per eye, no white highlight. She is physically tired and quietly matter-of-fact, not worried or tragic. Make skin PALE, low-saturation ivory, broad gray-rose under-eye and cheek shadows, preserving connected calm forehead/cheek/nose planes and adult mid-to-late-30s anatomy. NO rosy healthy orange glow or cosmetic blush. Her oval face, slightly round nose tip, chestnut loose bun, and restrained slightly parted lips remain. Enlarge the FACE and compress the neck: full forehead to chin nearly fills the useful canvas, chin at logical row 85, 4–5 logical pixels of neck maximum, only 8–10 pixels of narrow gray-mauve coarse blouse collar and oatmeal folded blanket edge at bottom. Do not make the face small to fit the hair. Reduce excessive hair texture to 3–4 major dark chestnut masses. Keep bun and ears inside canvas with 1–2 pixels of safety margin. No torso or shoulder bust, no props, no healing ad smile, no wounds.

TARGET: one vertical 74:100 dialogue portrait with TRANSPARENT background. Work like genuine hard-edged pixel art at a logical 74x100 grid and show enlarged, with intentional chunky connected 2D flat-color planes, at most 32 visible colors. The final export will be nearest-neighbor downsampled to exactly 74x100, so all major facial shapes must be readable at that size. No smooth rendering, no painterly gradients, no texture noise, no dithering, no decorative lights, no facial tattoos, no text, no frame. Broad chiselled nose and cheek shapes, clear age-specific expression. Face fills frame, very short neck and narrow collar, hair and ears wholly visible. Keep the background fully transparent.

revision_budget: one necessary revision after initial; no third imagegen call allowed
revision_basis: Independent QA batch09 concentrated feedback 2026-10-15T09:30Z, matching author visual review
validation_retry: Initial request had 6 reference paths; tool rejected before generation. Replaced with v1 target + four approved style references (5 max). No image generated by rejected request.
